title: Lahore Ring Road Increases Traffic Fines by Up to 900%
excerpt: The Lahore Ring Road Authority has significantly increased penalties for numerous traffic violations, with some fines surging by up to 900 percent.
body_html:
The Lahore Ring Road Authority has implemented a massive increase in penalties for traffic violations along the route. According to the recent update, fines for a wide range of infractions have risen dramatically, with certain penalties seeing hikes of up to 900 percent.

Drivers using the Lahore Ring Road will now face these substantially higher financial penalties for breaking traffic rules. The authority adjusted the fine structure to address various violations on the route, significantly increasing the cost of non-compliance for motorists.
